ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast between light-gray interior surfaces and black peripheral borders and linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous light-gray regions occupy the central 70% of both lobes; thick black solid banding observed on leading and trailing edges; dense, dark mottling concentrated in a radial pattern around the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 50 degrees; apex is sharply defined and vertically aligned with the peduncle junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge; frequency and amplitude of pixel-level variations increase toward the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a consistent convex curve from the notch to the lateral tips; leading edges show a distinct anterior-tapering curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of small, circular, high-contrast light-colored pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear rake marks crossing the light-gray areas of both lobes; most prominent on the left lobe trailing from the center toward the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark linear rake marks across the majority of the visible ventral surface; cluster of barnacles at both lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark vertical and radial pigmentation streaks emanating from the fluke-peduncle junction toward the interior of the lobes.
